title: 第十五章 天下攘攘第十六章 万鬼地窟
content_zh:
飞玄殿，位于北极天帝主殿侧后方，位置颇为偏僻。
周无纪还是第一次来，听道童介绍，飞玄殿专门用来存放道经典籍和各种文档。
这些道经典籍虽然重要，却和实际修行法门没多大关系。
宗门秘法都很精深奥妙，很多重要关节要点都是师徒秘传。
道门、佛门秘法又都极其看重仪轨，外人就是拿到秘法也是没用。
两人一路走到飞玄殿，是一个人都没碰到。
周无纪就明白了，飞玄殿就是个档案库和图书馆，也是下院最无聊最没油水的地方。
一平师叔混到飞玄殿当首座，可见一平师叔在下院也没什么分量。
小道童给周无纪送到门口，就急忙忙转身走了。
周无纪进了门，迎面就是飞玄殿正殿，青色基石，九阶台阶，面阔三间，进深六椽，单檐硬山顶。
整座大殿门柱尽皆掉漆，很多地方都露出木质原色。
规制却很讲究，是一座正式的大殿。只是年久失修，显得有些破旧。
一个小道童正在台阶上扫地，看到周无纪急忙下来稽首问礼：“师兄有事？”
“我叫周无纪，前来拜访一平师叔。”周无纪客气还礼。
小道童听是来拜访首座的，急忙引着周无纪去了偏殿。
进了房间，周无纪就看到一位道人躺靠在长榻上，道人面色红润，黑须黑发，身材微胖，躺在那姿态放松闲适，正是一平。
周无纪放下箱子深深鞠躬稽首：“师侄无纪拜见师叔。”
一平懒洋洋的坐起来一抬手：“不必客气了，坐。”
他随口问道：“我师兄怎么没来？”
“师父他出了意外、已经仙去了。”周无纪说起师父死讯，脸上都是掩饰不住的悲色。

“啊……”一平顿时从长榻上跳下来，他一脸不能置信看着周无纪，“师兄道法、武功俱都高绝，怎么出了意外？”
一平素来敬服一元的本事，知道这位师兄深藏不露，智慧、道法、武功都极其厉害。
如此人物，突然死了！他实在难以接受。
周无纪自然不能骗一平，当下把师父的事情详细说了。
“唉……师兄就是太要强了……这又何必、何必呢……”
一平连连叹息，北极派是玄门正宗，法门大都中正。一元修炼到走火入魔引发阴雷反噬，必然是修炼得极其高妙强大秘法。
想到一元对他种种关照，一平不禁老泪纵横。
周无纪看到一平失态大哭，他也更是伤心。只是他不习惯在外人面前展现本性，悲伤得非常克制。
一平终究是七品修者，很快控制住了情绪，他用袖子擦了擦脸上涕泪，哑着嗓子对周无纪：“无纪、杀人的事情不用担心，家属就是告状也要由天师府处理，绝不会让你吃亏。”
他又问道：“你师父去了，你先跟着我在下院修行，如何？”
“师叔，我已经晋级八品，我想继承师父的藏龙观。”
content_en:
Feixuan Hall is located behind the main hall of the Arctic Heavenly Emperor, in a rather remote location.
This was Zhou Wuji's first time here. He heard from the Taoist boy that Feixuan Hall was specially used to store Taoist scriptures and various documents.
Although these Taoist classics are important, they have little to do with actual practice.
The secret methods of the sect are very profound and profound, and many important points are secretly passed down from master to disciple.
Both Taoism and Buddhism attach great importance to rituals and rituals, and it would be useless for outsiders to obtain the secrets.
The two of them walked all the way to Feixuan Palace without meeting anyone.
Zhou Wuji understood that Feixuan Hall was just an archives and library, and it was also the most boring and unattractive place in the Lower House.
Uncle Yiping sneaked into Feixuan Hall and became the leader. It can be seen that Uncle Yiping has no weight in the lower courtyard.
The little Taoist boy walked Zhou Wuji to the door and hurriedly turned around and left.
When Zhou Wuji entered the door, he was faced with the main hall of Feixuan Hall, with blue foundation stone, nine steps, three rooms wide, six rafters deep, and a single eaves on the top of the hard top.
The paint on the door pillars of the entire hall is peeling off, and the original color of the wood is exposed in many places.
The rules are very particular, and it is a formal hall. It just fell into disrepair and looked a little shabby.
A little Taoist boy was sweeping the floor on the steps. When he saw Zhou Wuji, he hurriedly came down to pay homage and asked, "Senior brother, is there anything wrong?"
"My name is Zhou Wuji, and I'm here to visit Master Yiping." Zhou Wuji returned the courtesy politely.
The little Taoist boy heard that he was here to visit the chief minister and hurriedly led Zhou Wuji to the side hall.
Entering the room, Zhou Wuji saw a Taoist lying on the couch. The Taoist had a ruddy complexion, black beard and black hair, and a slightly fat figure. He was lying there in a relaxed and leisurely posture, just like Yiping.
Zhou Wuji put down the box and bowed deeply: "My nephew Wuji pays homage to my uncle."
Yiping lazily sat up and raised his hand: "You're welcome, sit down."
He asked casually: "Why didn't my senior brother come?"
"Master had an accident and has passed away." Zhou Wuji couldn't hide the sadness on his face when he talked about the news of his master's death.
"Ah..." Yiping immediately jumped down from the couch and looked at Zhou Wuji with a look of disbelief on his face, "Senior brother is extremely skilled in Taoism and martial arts, how come there was an accident?"
Yi Ping has always admired Yi Yuan's ability and knew that this senior brother had hidden secrets and was extremely powerful in wisdom, Taoism, and martial arts.
Such a character died suddenly! It was really hard for him to accept.
Zhou Wuji naturally couldn't deceive Yiping, so he immediately explained the master's affairs in detail.
"Sigh... Senior brother is just too strong... Why, why bother..."
Yiping sighed repeatedly, the Arctic sect is the orthodox sect of Xuanmen, and most of its methods are righteous. One Yuan's cultivation to the point of going crazy and triggering the backlash of Yin Thunder must be because he has cultivated an extremely powerful and powerful secret method.
Thinking of Yiyuan's care for him, Yiping couldn't help but burst into tears.
When Zhou Wuji saw Yiping losing his temper and crying, he was even more sad. It's just that he is not used to showing his true nature in front of outsiders, so he is very restrained in his grief.
Yiping was a seventh-grade cultivator after all, and he quickly controlled his emotions. He wiped the tears on his face with his sleeves, and said to Zhou Wuji in a hoarse voice: "Wuji, don't worry about the murder. Even if the family members file a complaint, it will be handled by the Tianshi Mansion. You will never suffer any loss."
He asked again: "Your master has gone, how about you follow me to practice in the lower courtyard first?"
"Uncle Master, I have been promoted to the eighth level. I want to inherit Master's Hidden Dragon Temple."
